title: Beacon Effect extractor
description: Adds a new craftable item to add your own effect to beacon
body:
Beacon Effect Extractor is a mod that allows you to extract active potion or status effects from yourself using a special item.

With this item, you can safely remove an effect from your player and store it. The extracted effect can then be inserted into a Beacon, allowing the Beacon to emit that exact effect to all nearby players.

This mod opens up new possibilities for automation, custom Beacon setups, and creative gameplay. No longer are you limited to vanilla Beacon effects — any effect you extract can become a permanent area buff.

Perfect for survival, technical worlds, and modded servers.
